info.name: Community Incident Pattern Analyzer - Mid-Term
info.description: Run the folders in order (Collection Runner works too). Step 0 seeds the data through the save endpoints and stores every id in collection variables used by the later requests. Dates are computed from today, so the incident reports are always in the future (the date rule of D1 rejects past dates). Start from an empty database.

exec: return i === 0 ? w.charAt(0).toLowerCase() + w.slice(1) : w.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + w.slice(1);

exec: pm.test("All REPORTED and ordered by incidentDate", function () { var r = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(r.length).to.eql(4); r.forEach(function (x, i) { pm.expect(x.status).to.eql('REPORTED'); if (i > 0) { pm.expect(x.incidentDate >= r[i - 1].incidentDate).to.be.true; } }); });

item.name: E2 Finding history of resident Divine (newest first, stores a finding id)

exec: pm.test("3 findings of that resident, newest recordedDate first", function () { var f = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(f.length).to.eql(3); f.forEach(function (x, i) { pm.expect(x.incidentReport.resident.nationalId).to.eql(pm.collectionVariables.get('nationalId')); if (i > 0) { pm.expect(x.recordedDate <= f[i - 1].recordedDate).to.be.true; } }); pm.collectionVariables.set('findingId', f[0].id); });

Part F - Reports and bulk updates

exec: pm.test("Rows are [status, count], no zero count", function () { var s = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(s.length).to.be.above(0); s.forEach(function (row) { pm.expect(['REPORTED','INVESTIGATING','CLOSED','DISMISSED']).to.include(row[0]); pm.expect(row[1]).to.be.above(0); }); });

item.name: F2 Check: reported1 is now DISMISSED

exec: pm.test("reported1 is in the DISMISSED list", function () { var d = pm.response.json().map(function (x) { return x.description; }); pm.expect(d).to.include('reported1'); });

pm.test("Keys in the required order, counts are numbers", function () { var s = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(Object.keys(s)).to.eql(['residents','responseOfficers','freeCells','incidentsToday','reported','findings']); pm.expect(s.residents).to.eql(5); pm.expect(s.responseOfficers).to.eql(3); });

item.name: Bonus Incident reports page by page (page 0, size 5, newest first)

exec: pm.test("5 rows with total pages and total elements", function () { var p = pm.response.json(); var te = p.totalElements !== undefined ? p.totalElements : p.page.totalElements; var tp = p.totalPages !== undefined ? p.totalPages : p.page.totalPages; pm.expect(p.content.length).to.eql(5); pm.expect(te).to.be.above(5); pm.expect(tp).to.be.above(1); p.content.forEach(function (x, i) { if (i > 0) { pm.expect(x.incidentDate <= p.content[i - 1].incidentDate).to.be.true; } }); });
